City of Inglewood

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  December 16, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Council Chambers on the 9th floor
at 11:35 a.m.:

  Members Present: Aisha Thompson, City Clerk Department
  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Ken Campos, Legal Department

  Staff Present:  Yakema Decatur, Administration Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

  1. The minutes of December 09, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Rachel Doe – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for providing
  photography services in the amount of $1,250.00. Motion carried unanimously.

  3. Eddie Olmos – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for providing
  audio and video recording services in the amount of $412.50. Motion carried
  unanimously.

  4. Gordon Anderson - Executive session to discuss recommended payment for consulting
  services for the proposed Inglewood Basketball Entertainment Center in the amount of
  $6,825.00. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

  There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 11:55 a.m. Adjournment
